Fact-sensitive claims verified or explicitly unresolved
language_foundation: No source identity or unfilled-template artifact

population: data/iteration-two-dialogue-screen-v1; exact manifest will be bound by the audit before selection
purpose: Prospective development review of the newly frozen proposed research pool; separate language-foundation suitability from conversation-SFT correctness.
rules: Read complete paths; shared nodes may be read once with exact lineage/text equality checks.
Retain original record hashes, strata and group inclusion probabilities; unread or partially read paths remain ungraded.
Unknown factual truth is not a verified falsehood or a factual-quality pass. A language-foundation judgment is not permission for conversation SFT.
Any observed critical privacy/content defect requires quarantine and policy reassessment; do not choose a production error bound from the observed results.
This prospective sample is not a calibrated production acceptance suite. Keep discovery, reused-group and fresh-group results separate.
No corpus admission follows automatically; an exact bounded delegated research decision and checked reader remain required.

selection.existing_review_groups: Report overlap explicitly. Previously read groups may recur; do not call overlapping judgments independent.
